title: Royal Rajasthan (6N/7D)
tagline: Gilded palaces of Jaipur, towering Mehrangarh in Jodhpur, and romantic sunset boat rides on Lake Pichola in Udaipur.

bestTime.notes: Pleasant, sunny days and cool royal evenings (12°C to 26°C); ideal for sightseeing forts, palaces, and desert drives.

visaInfo: No visa or domestic permits required for Indian travelers. Valid government-issued photo ID required at hotels.
overview: Step into the regal grandeur of the Land of Kings on an authentic journey through Rajasthan's three most fabled royal capitals: Jaipur, Jodhpur, and Udaipur. Ascend the imposing ramparts of Amber Fort in the Pink City, marvel at the intricate honeycomb façade of Hawa Mahal, and explore the astronomical wonders of Jantar Mantar. Travel west across arid desert scrubland to Jodhpur, the Blue City, where the sheer cliffside bastions of Mehrangarh Fort guard centuries of Rajput valor and Jaswant Thada's white marble shimmers. Wind south through the Aravalli hills to Udaipur, the City of Lakes. Wander through the sprawling courtyards of the City Palace, witness classical Rajasthani folk performances at Bagore Ki Haveli, and glide past the floating Lake Palace on a serene evening boat cruise across Lake Pichola. With verified heritage haveli stays, daily royal breakfasts and dinners, private air-conditioned vehicle transfers, and verified local historical guides, this journey brings Indian royal history to life with unmatched warmth.
highlights: Grand exploration of Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, and City Palace in Jaipur
Astronomical discoveries at UNESCO-listed Jantar Mantar observatory
Panoramic fortress views from Mehrangarh Fort towering above Jodhpur
Visit to the royal marble cenotaph of Jaswant Thada in the Blue City
Scenic drive through the scenic Aravalli hills to romantic Udaipur
Sunset boat cruise on Lake Pichola with views of the floating Lake Palace
Folk dance and puppet performance at historical Bagore Ki Haveli

itinerary.title: Arrival in the Pink City & Hawa Mahal Evening Exploration
itinerary.description: Arrive at Jaipur International Airport or Railway Station, where your private chauffeur welcomes you with traditional Rajasthani warmth. Transfer to your handpicked heritage haveli, adorned with ornate arches and tranquil courtyards. In the late afternoon, take a relaxed drive past the iconic pink sandstone lattice facade of Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds). Stroll through the lively Johari Bazaar and Bapu Bazaar, savoring fragrant kachoris and browsing colorful block-printed textiles and blue pottery. Return to your haveli for a welcoming royal Rajasthani dinner by candlelit courtyards.
itinerary.transferInfo: Private AC Vehicle (Airport to Hotel, 15 km, 35 mins)

itinerary.title: Amber Fort Ramparts, Jal Mahal & Royal City Palace
itinerary.description: After a royal breakfast, journey to the rugged hills of Amer to explore the majestic Amber Fort. Marvel at the gleaming Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) where candlelight creates a dazzling starry illusion, and admire the sweeping views over Maota Lake. Stop on your return to photograph the serene water palace of Jal Mahal resting gracefully in Man Sagar Lake. In the afternoon, visit the sprawling City Palace complex and the astronomical wonders of UNESCO World Heritage Jantar Mantar. Enjoy an authentic dinner featuring Dal Baati Churma in a heritage courtyard setting.
itinerary.transferInfo: Private AC Vehicle (Full day city touring, 45 km)

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur & Mehrangarh Sunset Ramparts
itinerary.description: Depart Jaipur after breakfast on a scenic western highway drive toward the sun-drenched Thar desert fringes of Jodhpur. Arrive by early afternoon in the Blue City and check in to your heritage hotel. Head straight to the monumental Mehrangarh Fort, perched atop a 400-foot cliff, to explore its royal palanquins, weaponry museum, and vast courtyards. Watch the sun dip over the sprawling sea of indigo-blue painted houses below from the fort's western cannon ramparts. Visit nearby Jaswant Thada, the serene white marble royal cenotaph, before an evening rooftop dinner.
itinerary.transferInfo: Private AC Vehicle (330 km, approx. 6 hours via NH25)

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Udaipur via Ranakpur Jain Temple
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast before driving south through the winding Aravalli Range toward Udaipur. Break your journey at Ranakpur to marvel at the 15th-century marble Jain Temple, renowned for its 1,444 uniquely carved pillars where no two carvings are identical. Continue through lush green valleys, arriving in the romantic City of Lakes by late afternoon. Check into your lakeview hotel, unwind with refreshing spiced tea, and take an evening promenade along Fateh Sagar Lake as decorative streetlights reflect softly across the ripples. Relish a lakeside multi-course dinner under starry skies.
itinerary.transferInfo: Private AC Vehicle (260 km, approx. 5.5 hours)

itinerary.title: Grand City Palace, Saheliyon Ki Bari & Sunset Pichola Cruise
itinerary.description: Spend a captivating day uncovering Udaipur's royal heritage. Begin with a guided exploration of the magnificent City Palace, the largest palace complex in Rajasthan, admiring its peacocks mosaics, glass mirror chambers, and panoramic lake balconies. Visit Saheliyon Ki Bari (Garden of the Maids of Honor) with its lotus pools and marble elephant fountains. In the late afternoon, board a private boat on Lake Pichola, gliding past Jag Mandir and the world-famous Taj Lake Palace as the setting sun bathes the palace walls in brilliant gold. Enjoy dinner overlooking the illuminated lake.

itinerary.title: Monsoon Palace Sajjangarh & Folk Cultural Evening
itinerary.description: Drive up the winding peak to the hilltop Sajjangarh Fort (Monsoon Palace), which offers dramatic 360-degree vistas across the entire lake valley and surrounding mountain sanctuaries. Spend the afternoon shopping for authentic miniature paintings, silver jewelry, and handcrafted leather journals in the quaint artisan lanes near Jagdish Temple. At dusk, witness the celebrated Dharohar Rajasthani folk dance and puppet performance at historical Bagore Ki Haveli on Gangaur Ghat, followed by a celebratory farewell dinner featuring authentic Mewari specialties.

itinerary.title: Udaipur Farewell & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Savor your final breakfast overlooking the calm waters of Lake Pichola. Depending on your flight schedule, enjoy a relaxed morning walk around the heritage ghats or pick up last-minute handmade souvenirs and spices. Your chauffeur will assist with luggage and transfer you comfortably to Maharana Pratap Airport or Udaipur Railway Station for your flight home, concluding an unforgettable journey through the royal kingdoms of Rajasthan.

faqs.question: What is the best time of year to visit Rajasthan?
faqs.answer: October through March is the ideal season, offering sunny pleasant daytime temperatures around 22°C to 26°C and cool crisp evenings, perfect for outdoor palace exploration.

faqs.question: Are the hotels authentic royal heritage properties?
faqs.answer: Yes, we exclusively partner with verified heritage havelis and historic boutique palace hotels that feature traditional Rajasthani architecture, ornate jharokhas, and courtyard pools.

faqs.question: Is the Lake Pichola boat cruise included in the package?
faqs.answer: Yes, standard boat cruise tickets across Lake Pichola offering close views of the Taj Lake Palace and Jag Mandir island are included in the package cost.

faqs.question: Can this itinerary be customized for different cities?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can easily add extensions to the golden sand dunes of Jaisalmer or Pushkar by clicking the Customize Trip button on the site.

faqs.question: Is Rajasthan safe for family travel and senior citizens?
faqs.answer: Rajasthan is one of the safest and most hospitable destinations in India. Our private vehicles and attentive drivers ensure senior citizens and children travel with complete comfort.

faqs.question: Are pure vegetarian and Jain meals available throughout the tour?
faqs.answer: Yes, Rajasthan is world-renowned for its rich vegetarian cuisine. All our partner hotels and recommended restaurants provide authentic pure vegetarian and Jain meal preparations.
